narration.text: Which AI helps write a week of blog posts in an hour, free?

Number five, Midjourney. This tool generates images that are truly stunning, moving far beyond anything you would find in a stock photo library. It feels like you have a professional artist on demand.
At number four, Opus Clip. You can feed it long video and it will automatically cut, caption, and optimise it into short, viral clips. It's like having an entire video editing team.
Number three is ElevenLabs. This AI can clone your voice with incredible accuracy. You can then use it to generate lifelike speech for podcasts, audiobooks, or marketing, all in your own voice.
Coming in at number two, ChatGPT 4o. This free version of ChatGPT excels at brainstorming content ideas, drafting scripts, and even helping with coding. It is a true all-rounder for any creator.
And the number one AI tool is Gamma AI. This incredible tool creates beautiful presentations, documents, and web pages from simple text prompts. It is like magic for visual content.
Gamma AI is a game-changer for instant visual content. Did we miss your favourite? Tell us in the comments below!

description: Discover five AI tools that feel almost too powerful for content creation. These tools can help you generate stunning visuals, turn long videos into viral shorts, and even clone your voice for various projects, all with surprising ease.
